schema:name: Kramer (Russ) Collection
schema:description: A selection of 60 photographs from the Russ Kramer collection (D-817) documenting coffee cultivation, harvesting, processing, quality evaluation, and trade. The photographs include Hacienda La Minita in Costa Rica and coffee-producing locations in Brazil, Colombia, Ethiopia, Honduras, Indonesia, Nicaragua, Rwanda, and Tanzania, along with coffee tasting in South Korea.
